in_sanskrit.name: सदाशिव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is always benevolent, eternal and omnipresent. A form of Lord Shiva.

in_hindi.name: सदाशिव
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is always Shiva. A form of Lord Shiva.

in_tamil.name: சதாஷிவ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who possesses eternal consciousness and wisdom. A form of Lord Shiva.

in_telugu.name: సదాశివ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is always the lord, the controller. A form of Lord Shiva.

in_marathi.name: Sadashiva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे The eternal lord
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sadashiva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sadashiva is a form of Lord Shiva, representing the eternal, unchanging aspect of the god. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'sada' (eternal) and 'shiva' (god).

in_bengali.name: Sadashiva
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ The eternal lord
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sadashiva একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sadashiva is a form of Lord Shiva, representing the eternal, unchanging aspect of the god. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'sada' (eternal) and 'shiva' (god).
